title: Concept: Lockfile resolves a package from a bare IP address
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry served from an IP literal rather than a named host, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An IP literal bypasses the TLS name check, so the connection cannot prove it reached the host the review approved.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: An IP literal bypasses the TLS name check, so the connection cannot prove it reached the host the review approved.
